definitions.explanation: Attached to the negative stem of a verb (the form before ない), it says that one action happens without another taking place. It means the same as 〜ないで but sounds a little more written and tidy. する becomes せずに and {来|く}る becomes {来|こ}ずに.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何|なに}も→何も：03874_nanimo⟧⟦{言|い}わ→言う：00515_iu⟧ずに⟦{帰|かえ}った→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: He went home without saying anything.

examples.japanese: ⟦{傘|かさ}→傘：00639_kasa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}た→持つ：00478_motsu⟧ずに⟦{出|で}かけて→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧しまった。
examples.english: I went out without taking an umbrella.

examples.japanese: ⟦{朝|あさ}ご{飯|はん}→朝ご飯：02843_asagohan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べ→食べる：00396_taberu⟧ずに⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧{子|こ}ども⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧そうだ。
examples.english: I hear more and more children go to school without eating breakfast.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{誰|だれ}→誰：00534_dare⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}→相談：02089_soudan⟧せずに、⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{辞|や}める⟦{決心|けっしん}→決心：02700_kesshin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Without consulting anyone, he decided on his own to quit the company.

notes:
ず is the classical negative, still alive in set patterns; ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ links it to the following verb.

FORMS:
- ⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧ → ⟦{書|か}か→書く：00477_kaku⟧ずに
- ⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧ → ⟦{食|た}べ→食べる：00396_taberu⟧ずに
- ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ → せずに (not しずに)
- ⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧ → {来|こ}ずに

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜ずにはいられない: cannot help doing (⟦{笑|わら}わ→笑う：00685_warau⟧ずにはいられない)
- 〜ずに⟦{済|す}む→済む：01950_sumu⟧: to get by without having to do (⟦{払|はら}わ→払う：00535_harau⟧ずに⟦{済|す}んだ→済む：01950_sumu⟧)
- ⟦{休|やす}ま→休む：00606_yasumu⟧ずに: without a break

SIMILAR WORDS:
- 〜ないで: without doing — the same meaning, more conversational
- 〜ず: the bare form, used to join clauses in writing (⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}ら→降る：00839_furu⟧ず、…)
